نستمع (form VIII)
# نَسْتَمِعُ (nastamiʕu) /nas.ta.mi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# نُسْتَمَعُ (nustamaʕu) /nus.ta.ma.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# نَسْتَمِعَ (nastamiʕa) /nas.ta.mi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# نُسْتَمَعَ (nustamaʕa) /nus.ta.ma.ʕa/:
